dict.string: Cloudbreak Files needs access to your Desktop folder so you can browse, preview and edit the files you add.
Cloudbreak Files needs access to your Documents folder so you can browse, preview and edit the files you add.
Cloudbreak Files needs access to your Downloads folder so you can browse, preview and edit the files you add.
Cloudbreak Files needs access to your Pictures folder so you can browse and preview photos you keep there.
Cloudbreak Files needs access to your Movies folder so you can browse and preview videos you keep there.
Cloudbreak Files needs access to your Music folder so you can browse and preview audio you keep there.
Cloudbreak Files can list photos from your Photos library when you browse the Photos folder in Local Files.
Cloudbreak Files needs access to external drives so you can browse, preview and edit the files you add.
Cloudbreak Files needs access to network volumes so you can browse, preview and edit the files you add.
Cloudbreak Files uses your local network for P2P library sharing and discovering nearby peers and servers.
